create_VideoLoader_dataset: create a VideoLoader PyTorch Dataset from a CSV to decode videos into tensors with configurable framerate and size
build_VideoCompressor: build a VideoCompressor to compress videos from a CSV list using ffmpeg with a configurable CRF quality setting
run_VideoDownloader: run a VideoDownloader to wget videos from URLs listed in a CSV to local output paths
extract_AvKeyframeVideoCompressor: extract keyframes from videos using pyav and save sampled frames as JPG images to an output directory
verify_VideoVerifier: verify video files by probing their stream info using ffprobe through the VideoVerifier class
